references: WoodMac Energy Storage Apr-2026 ($85/kWh LFP pack)
_meta.note: Degradation = calendar + cycle. Cycle life = full-equivalent cycles to 80% SoH at 25C, 0.5C/0.5C, 100% DoD unless noted. Derate multipliers applied in engine. SSB_PROTO is flagged prototype-only with resale=null per IEA Global EV Outlook 2026.

chemistries.name: Lithium Iron Phosphate
chemistries.coulombic_notes: Flat OCV — SoC hard to estimate from voltage; needs coulomb counting. Excellent heat tolerance.
chemistries.fast_charge_tolerance: High — 1.5C–2C sustained, 3C peak (Shenxing Pro). Best for delivery / hot climates / daily DCFC.
chemistries.cold_sensitivity: High below 5C (lithium plating risk, +25% internal resistance at 0C). Needs heat pump + preheat.
chemistries.verdict_plain_english: Buy LFP if you ride daily, fast-charge often, or live where it is HOT. Slightly heavier, slightly less range, but lasts years longer and is cheaper to replace.

chemistries.name: Nickel Manganese Cobalt 8-1-1
example_cells: LG E78 / Tesla Model Y LR (LG)
chemistries.fast_charge_tolerance: Medium — 1C–1.5C sustained. Frequent 2C+ DCFC accelerates cracking. Keep 20–80% for daily.
chemistries.cold_sensitivity: Medium — better than LFP in winter (~-22% at -7C vs -32% LFP without preheat).
chemistries.heat_sensitivity: High — keep under 40C; needs liquid cooling (Tesla octovalve / Hyundai).
chemistries.verdict_plain_english: Buy NMC if you need MAX range in a light pack and live where it is COLD or you do highway miles. Baby it: home-charge to 80%, DCFC only on trips.

chemistries.name: Nickel Manganese Cobalt 6-2-2
chemistries.verdict_plain_english: Balanced older NMC. Fine used if SoH >88% and price reflects ~8-yr life.

chemistries.name: Lithium Manganese Iron Phosphate
chemistries.verdict_plain_english: 2026 sweet spot: LFP durability + near-NMC range. Ask dealer for written chemistry proof — many claim LMFP, ship LFP.

chemistries.name: Sodium-ion (Naxtra / CATL Gen2)
chemistries.cold_sensitivity: Very low — best winter budget chemistry.
chemistries.verdict_plain_english: Cheapest + toughest. Slightly less range. Perfect for fleets, mopeds, 3W. Resale still discounted (buyer unfamiliarity) — negotiate hard.

chemistries.name: Lithium Titanate
chemistries.verdict_plain_english: Bus/3W only. Outlives the chassis. Too heavy/expensive for cars/scooters.

chemistries.name: Solid-state prototype (not modelled)
chemistries.fast_charge_tolerance: Lab claims <10min; unproven at pack scale
chemistries.verdict_plain_english: PROTOTYPE ONLY per IEA 2026: premium segments until early-2030s. Engine returns resale=null + pages carry noindex. Never invent a curve.
